Definition: Ethan, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ethan = "enduring"; 1) an Ezrahite known for his wisdom; 2) a grandson of Judah, father of Azariah; 3) a Kohathite descendant of Levi; 4) a Merarite son of Kushaiah, descendant of Levi
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
